method: A 1280x720 physical desktop at 100%, 125%, and 200% browser zoom was represented by the corresponding CSS layout viewports 1280x720, 1024x576, and 640x360. This verifies reflow/containment behavior, not the browser's zoom control itself.

fix.finding: At the 640x360 CSS viewport, a max-width media query incorrectly displayed the touch-only DESKTOP REQUIRED overlay on a fine-pointer desktop.
fix.change: Removed viewport width from the overlay media trigger; coarse/no-hover input remains the CSS fallback and JavaScript user-agent/pointer policy remains unchanged.
fix.focused_result: 2 files, 3 tests passed including reduced-motion precedence

limitations: The in-app browser exposes viewport control but not its native browser-zoom control, so this is a CSS-layout equivalent rather than a literal zoom-toggle recording.
The 200% layout is mechanically contained but still needs human five-second readability review.
Pointer-lock interaction remains unavailable in this embedded browser.
